units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 9:3">Esth. R. to V, 12</cite> <he>לאחר שעשה העץ</he> after having made the gallows.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 2:3">Tam. II, 3</cite>, a. fr. <he>עץ שמן</he> pine-wood.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:7">Gen. R. s. 15</cite> <he>אילן שעֵצוֹ נאכל וכ׳</he> a tree whose wood is as fit to eat as its fruit. Sifra Emor, Par. 12, ch. XVI, v. <cite ref="P01004"><he>עָנָף</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Pesachim 30b:13">Pes. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>עץ פרור</he> wooden pot-ladle.—Pl. <he>עֵצִים</he>; constr. <cite ref="P01114"><he>עֲצֵי</he></cite>. Tam. l. c. <he>כל הע׳ כשרין וכ׳</he> all kinds of wood are fit for the altar pile. Ib. 5 <he>עצי תאנה</he> wood of a fig-tree.
